'''Vorrel''' was a [[General/Legends|general]] who led the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces at the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]], an Imperial assault on a [[Arda Base|Rebel base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arda I]].<ref name="OAA1" />
